name: External CIO Control
description: The command and MCP surface through which Codex or Antigravity should independently inspect evidence, authorize entries, and make discretionary management decisions; it also contains the legacy autonomous loop that conflicts with that authority model.

name: Market Data & SmartTrading Bridge
description: Fail-closed live Kite market access and the read-only SmartTrading connector supplying telemetry, market context, and collision information without cross-project writes.

name: Analytics & Cockpit Evidence
description: Option-chain, Greeks, microstructure, volatility, technical, and composite-edge engines that compress market data into evidence for the external CIO rather than owning the final decision.

name: Paper Ledger & Safety Audit
description: Independent paper-trade persistence, statutory-friction accounting, decision journaling, and the SQLite artifacts that make positions and actions auditable.

name: Validation & Historical Evidence
description: Logic-test workflows, regression coverage, cached market histories, and validation reports used to evaluate claims without driving a mandatory trade decision.

name: Policy, Documentation & Runtime State
description: The written operating contract, intended risk configuration, analysis configuration, and generated snapshots that give the CIO operational context.
